messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 6(3)

Article 6 Freedom of movement. 3. At trade fairs, exhibitions, demonstrations, and such like, Member States shall not prevent the showing of machinery or partly completed machinery which does not conform to this Directive, provided that a visible sign clearly indicates that it does not conform and that it will not be made available until it has been brought into conformity. Furthermore, during demonstrations of such non-conforming machinery or partly completed machinery, adequate safety measures shall be taken to ensure the protection of persons.

response.text:
Member States | shallNotPrevent | showing of non-conforming machinery or partly completed machinery | provided a visible sign clearly indicates non-conformity and the machinery is not made available until conformity is achieved | "Member States shall not prevent the showing of machinery or partly completed machinery which does not conform to this Directive, provided that a visible sign clearly indicates that it does not conform"
non-conforming machinery on show | carriesVisibleSign | clearly indicating it does not conform | at trade fairs, exhibitions, demonstrations, and such like | "provided that a visible sign clearly indicates that it does not conform"
non-conforming machinery | notMadeAvailableBefore | brought into conformity | displayed at trade fairs, exhibitions, demonstrations | "it will not be made available until it has been brought into conformity"
adequate safety measures | shallBeTaken | to ensure protection of persons | during demonstrations of non-conforming machinery or partly completed machinery | "during demonstrations of such non-conforming machinery or partly completed machinery, adequate safety measures shall be taken to ensure the protection of persons"
